summary: Clearway on a busy arterial by a bridge and junction; nowhere to stop.

drivers.seclusion: Fully exposed beside a major junction; shops 18 m and homes 35 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is a live lane edge of a multi-lane road; no pull-off or lay-by.
drivers.traffic: Heavy, multi-lane arterial with signals; constant noise.
drivers.convention: Clearway with tow away signs, Mon-Sat 7am-7pm; no parked cars along the kerb.

sun_shade: Open to sun; bridge shades the upper part.
cannot_judge: Whether the clearway lane is usable overnight

best_section.where: Walker Street southbound lane edge past the bridge, beside the grass island
